name: Astral Drifter

features.name: Feature: Divine Contact
features.description:
You gain the Magic Initiate from the Player's Handbook|PHB and must choose cleric for the feat.

In the Astral Sea, you crossed paths with a wandering deity. The encounter was brief and nonviolent, yet it made a lasting impression on you. This deity saw fit to share one secret or obscure bit of cosmic lore with you. Work with your DM to determine the details of this knowledge and its impact on the campaign.

Roll on the Divine Contact table to determine which deity you encountered, or work with your DM to identify a more suitable choice.

name: Wildspacer

features.name: Feature: Wildspace Adaptation
features.description: You gain the Tough from the Player's Handbook|PHB. In addition, you learned how to adapt to zero gravity. Being weightless doesn't give you disadvantage on any of your melee attack rolls (see "Weightlessness|AAG|2|Weightlessness" in chapter 2|AAG|2).

Close Encounter.

You had a harrowing encounter with one of Wildspace's many terrors. You escaped with your life, but the encounter left you with a scar or two, or perhaps a recurring nightmare. Roll on the Close Encounter table to determine which creature nearly got the best of you. Creatures marked with an asterisk appear in Boo's Astral Menagerie|BAM; the others are described in the Monster Manual|MM.

d10Creature
1Beholder
2Cosmic horror*
3Feyr*
4Lunar dragon|bestiary|source=BAM|search=lunar dragon*
5Mind flayer
6Neh-thalggu*
7Neogi*
8Space clown*
9Vampirate*
10Void scavver*
Feature: Wildspace Adaptation.

You gain the Tough from the Player's Handbook|PHB. In addition, you learned how to adapt to zero gravity. Being weightless doesn't give you disadvantage on any of your melee attack rolls (see "Weightlessness|AAG|2|Weightlessness" in chapter 2|AAG|2).

**Close Encounter**

You had a harrowing encounter with one of Wildspace's many terrors. You escaped with your life, but the encounter left you with a scar or two, or perhaps a recurring nightmare. **Feature: Wildspace Adaptation**

You gain the Tough from the Player's Handbook|PHB. In addition, you learned how to adapt to zero gravity. Being weightless doesn't give you disadvantage on any of your melee attack rolls (see "Weightlessness|AAG|2|Weightlessness" in chapter 2|AAG|2).
